records.title: Make Geometry Matter for Spatial Reasoning
records.reason: GeoSR changes VLM training to encourage use of geometry tokens for spatial reasoning; no reduced inference tokens, memory, latency, or serving cost is demonstrated.

records.title: Energy-Aware Multilingual Evaluation of Large Language Models
records.reason: The MDPI DOI/publisher page returned HTTP 429; no primary abstract/full text could be checked. The packet description suggests direct energy measurement of LLM inference, which could be highly relevant, but final classification must remain borderline pending source access.

records.title: MSRL: Scaling Generative Multimodal Reward Modeling via Multi-Stage Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: MSRL is a multi-stage reinforcement-learning and distillation method for multimodal reward-model training; results concern training efficiency/performance, not model serving.

records.title: MegaFlow: Zero-Shot Large Displacement Optical Flow
records.reason: MegaFlow is an optical-flow method using pretrained vision features and iterative refinement; the target model is vision, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Thinking with Tables: Enhancing Multi-Modal Tabular Understanding via Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
records.reason: Thinking with Tables is a program-aided reasoning framework for multimodal tabular QA; it reports accuracy improvements but no measured reduction in LLM tokens, latency, memory, or inference cost.
